Third-party sources used by the launcher (OpenTricky.exe), copied unmodified
from their official repositories (one local fix in RmlUi, below); each folder
keeps its licence file.

  rmlui/     RmlUi 6.3            https://github.com/mikke89/RmlUi            MIT (LICENSE.txt)
             (Include, Source, CMake, and the SDL platform + GL3 renderer backends only)
             Local fix, marked "OpenTricky" in Source/Core/ElementStyle.cpp: a font-size or
             a line-height written with a variable (var()) is computed again when the
             variable changes (6.3 kept the old value unless the font size changed).
  sdl3/      SDL release-3.4.8    https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL           zlib (LICENSE.txt)
             (CMakeLists.txt, cmake, include, src, wayland-protocols, build-scripts/*.cmake)
             (also in the game, SSX Tricky.exe: the PlayStation controllers option,
             port/src/pad_sdl.c)
  freetype/  FreeType 2.14.3      https://github.com/freetype/freetype        FTL or GPLv2 (LICENSE.TXT, docs/FTL.TXT)
             (used under the FTL, which asks for a credit in the documentation)
  miniz/     miniz 3.1.2          https://github.com/richgel999/miniz         MIT (LICENSE)
             (miniz.c and miniz.h of the release file miniz-3.1.2.zip, sha256
             f0446d863f9c19926ad9483c523fdc42e42b8d4a6a431d27e09d49c79a140d9a)
  monocypher/ Monocypher 4.0.2    https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher  BSD-2-Clause or CC0 (LICENCE.md)
             (src/monocypher.[ch], src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.[ch]: the
             release signature; taken from the crate monocypher-sys
             4.0.2, sha256-checked against crates.io, whose Monocypher/ is the
             4.0.2 tree -- hence "version __git__" in the file headers)

Parts of these sources under their own licence, compiled into the launcher
(SDL's into the game as well; their licences are in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt
too):
  sdl3/      src/hidapi: HIDAPI 0.14.0 (GPL 3.0, BSD or its original licence,
             LICENSE.txt; used under the original one, LICENSE-orig.txt);
             src/video/stb_image.h: stb_image 2.30 (MIT or Unlicense);
             src/video/miniz.h: miniz 1.15 (Unlicense); src/video/yuv2rgb:
             yuv2rgb (BSD 3-clause, LICENSE).
  freetype/  src/gzip: zlib 1.3.1 (zlib licence); src/bdf, src/pcf and
             src/base/fthash.c: X11-style licences (LICENSE.TXT).
  rmlui/     Include/RmlUi/Core/Containers: robin_hood and itlib (MIT,
             LICENSE.txt); Backends/RmlUi_Include_GL3.h: the OpenGL loader
             generated by glad, with khrplatform.h (Khronos, MIT-style).

Used by the game (SSX Tricky.exe): miniz (above, the same files), the PNG writer of its
screenshots (F12), deflate only.

Fonts in port/launcher/app/ui/fonts: Inter and Exo 2 (SIL Open Font License
1.1, OFL-*.txt beside them), from https://github.com/google/fonts. Bullet
(bullet-smallcaps.otf), from House Industries, has its own licence and is not
covered by the Open Font License (see port/launcher/app/licenses-head.txt, and
THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt in the release).

Licences only (no source here) of the code the MinGW-w64 toolchain (MSYS2
UCRT64) links into the executables, copied unmodified from its share/licenses
folder:
  mingw-w64/ crt/COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt: the MinGW-w64 runtime, in the
             launcher and the game;
             winpthreads/COPYING: winpthreads, in the launcher.
  notices/   gcc-runtime-exception.txt: libgcc/COPYING.RUNTIME (the same file
             as libstdc++'s), the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1 of the GCC
             runtime (GNU GPL 3.0 or later, with this exception): libgcc and
             inline functions of GCC's headers, in the launcher and the game;
             libstdc++, in the launcher.

Notices only, for THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt (read by the launcher's build,
port/launcher/app/CMakeLists.txt): passages of the sources above, copied
unmodified from the lines given:
  notices/   freetype-bdf.txt: freetype/src/bdf/README, lines 102-144;
             freetype-pcf.txt: freetype/src/pcf/README, lines 69-88;
             freetype-pcfutil.txt: freetype/src/pcf/pcfutil.c, lines 3-23;
             freetype-fthash.txt: freetype/src/base/fthash.c, lines 10-30;
             freetype-zlib.txt: freetype/src/gzip/zlib.h, lines 4-20;
             sdl-stb-image.txt: sdl3/src/video/stb_image.h, lines 8229-8265;
             sdl-miniz.txt: sdl3/src/video/miniz.h, lines 5075-5098;
             khrplatform.txt: rmlui/Backends/RmlUi_Include_GL3.h, lines
             1001-1020 (khrplatform.h, in the OpenGL loader of RmlUi's GL3
             backend, generated by glad).
